body:
Full-codebase review, web finding. Verified by reading both clients and the server.

After `POST /lists/{id}/leave` the web client only calls `refresh()`. The server deletes the membership (no tombstone, since other members remain), and the pull is scoped to memberships, so the delta says nothing about that list and `applyResponse` — which removes a row only on a `deleted` tombstone — keeps it in the in-memory map. The list therefore stays on the overview until a full page reload. Opening it and ticking an item pushes to a list the account is no longer on, which the server refuses; see the server finding about that refusal being an unquarantinable 403 that also rolls the rest of the batch back.

Android hard-deletes the row locally (`ListsRepo.removeLocally`, "only for leaving a shared list, never synced").

Fix direction: give the sync store a "forget this list and its items" action and call it from `handleLeave` before navigating.
title: Web: a list you have left stays on the overview until a reload
